annotations.title: Screen Companies That Must Raise Capital

description: Companies with imminent capital raise needs based on estimated cash runway. Defaults to companies with less than 6 months of cash remaining, sorted by urgency (lowest runway first): distressed companies, imminent dilution situations and potential financing catalysts. Runway is estimated from the current burn rate. Companies whose estimated cash is already exhausted are included by default and listed first: they carry cash_runway_months null with cashRunwayReason "estimate_would_be_negative" (the last cash figure, dated cashRunwayAsOf, rolled forward by the burn rate is below zero today). That is an estimate from a dated balance (estimated exhausted as of today, from the last cash figure as of cashRunwayAsOf), not a reported zero balance and not a statement that the company has no cash. Rows also carry estimatedCurrentCash / estimatedCashAsOf (dilution-snapshot cash projection; null = not measured) and listingMarket.

includeExhausted.description: Include companies whose estimated cash is already exhausted (default: true)

industry.description: Filter by company industry (exact match, e.g. "Biotechnology", "Software")

market.description: Listing market: "otc" (OTC Markets) or "exchange" (NASDAQ / NYSE / NYSE American / Arca / Cboe)

maxMonths.description: Maximum months of cash runway to filter by (default: 6)
